subject: SIG follow-up: bespoke control crosswalk + artifact plan
messages:
From: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@procureit.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
Cc: sourcing@procureit.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire follow-up and evidence packaging

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement at ProcureIT has a SIG questionnaire that requests detailed control-level mappings and supporting artifacts for our security review. We received an ask from our InfoSec lead to see a tailored crosswalk showing how Redwood maps SIG/CC controls to your SOC 2 and ISO evidence, plus representative artifacts that substantiate each control (logs, policies, configuration screenshots, attestation excerpts).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide a control crosswalk (SIG v2.0) to SOC 2/ISO 27001 artifacts
- Deliver sample evidence for high-risk controls (access provisioning, privileged access, change mgmt, incident response)
- Share a timeline for delivery (we have a board review on 4/22)

ProcureIT can execute an NDA if required. Please let me know the point people and an ETA.

Thanks,
Laura Gomez
Senior Sourcing Manager
ProcureIT

Attachments: procureit-sig.pdf (procurement package)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
To: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@procureit.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com, jordan_blake@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up and evidence packaging

Hi Laura —

Appreciate the clear ask. Redwood can absolutely provide a SIG-to-SOC2/ISO crosswalk and a package of representative artifacts for the controls you flagged. Quick plan:

1) I attached an initial crosswalk (SIG_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx) that maps SIG control IDs to our SOC 2 control families and the ISO clauses we reference.
2) Neha will lead artifact collection for privileged access and change management. Jordan will organize the evidence index and timeline. Marissa will attach the latest SOC 2 attestation pdf.
3) We can deliver a first pass evidence bundle by 4/18 to give you time for board review. If ProcureIT needs a full extraction for every single SIG row we can quote time for a comprehensive extraction, but we recommend the targeted high-risk controls first.

Please confirm NDA preference and whether redaction on screenshots is required.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: SIG_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up and evidence packaging

Sergio / team —

I’ll take privileged access and incident response artifacts. Planned artifacts:
- Privileged access: min-privilege policy excerpt, PAM architecture diagram (redacted), recent privileged user change log (CSV stub)
- Incident response: IR plan excerpt, one anonymized post-incident root cause summary, timeline of response for a tenant-impacting incident (redacted)

Note on redaction: screenshots with tenant identifiers will be blurred; audit logs will have internal IDs stable but not customer PII. We should flag any artifacts that require Legal review.

ETA: I can assemble the first bucket by 4/15 EOD.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Program Manager
redwood.example.com

Attachments: evidence_index_readme.txt

From: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up and evidence packaging

Team —

I created a lightweight timeline in the shared drive and sketched responsibilities:
- 4/13: Gather config screenshots + policy excerpts (Neha)
- 4/15: Compile logs and export samples (Jordan)
- 4/16: Marissa to attach SOC 2 attestation and sign-off notes
- 4/18: Internal QA and package handoff to Sergio for external delivery

I will also generate an evidence index CSV with pointers to Drive files (path + brief description). Laura — if you prefer a different format (DocuSign bundle, S3 link), tell us and we’ll adapt.

-Jordan Blake
Security Solutions Engineer
redwood.example.com

Attachments: (none)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com, jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up and evidence packaging

I uploaded the SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf and a short sign-off memo to the Drive folder and added basic metadata to the evidence index. I recommend we include a one-page readme that explains our redaction approach and contact points for deeper follow-ups.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
redwood.example.com

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf

From: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@procureit.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
Cc: sourcing@procureit.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up and evidence packaging

Thanks, Sergio — that timeline works for ProcureIT. We do require an NDA before we accept artifact packs that include internal logs. I’ve attached our standard NDA to this thread (ProcureIT_NDA_2027.docx) and can also initiate it via DocuSign — preference is DocuSign.

Two small asks:
1) Can you add a short summary table in the package indicating which artifacts are redacted and why?
2) For the board, can you provide a one-paragraph statement on Redwood’s model isolation guarantees for dedicated tenants?

If you can get the NDA sent by EOD we’ll queue the review and aim for board clearance on 4/22.

Best,
Laura

Attachments: ProcureIT_NDA_2027.docx

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com
To: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@procureit.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com, jordan_blake@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up and evidence packaging

Laura —

Thanks, will do. I’ll send the NDA via DocuSign in the next 30 minutes. We’ll include:
- Readme table listing artifacts and redaction rationale
- One-paragraph model isolation statement (dedicated and hosted modes) signed off by Product Security

We’ll target the evidence bundle delivery to ProcureIT Drive link by 4/18 and will flag anything that requires Legal review earlier.

Sergio

Attachments: (DocuSign request in progress)
